objective: Determine whether ACT_NOW, USE_TOOL, and WAIT_OR_ABSTAIN can be distinguished reliably, and whether tool judgment belongs in rules, a learned supervisor, the main model, or a hybrid.
evaluation_role: internal held-out development benchmark; this is not a sealed-season gate

dataset.matched_group_unit: tool opportunity plus resolved, unresolved, and nearby context-sufficient states
dataset.heldout_open_policy: Fit and select all thresholds on train/development; score heldout exactly once after every candidate artifact and model prompt is frozen.

static_rule_definition.note: The 0.15 threshold is precommitted and intentionally differs from the broader 0.12 source-opportunity boundary.

metrics.required_tool_recall: true USE_TOOL predicted USE_TOOL / all true USE_TOOL
metrics.tool_precision: true USE_TOOL predicted USE_TOOL / all predicted USE_TOOL
metrics.unsafe_direct_action_rate: predicted ACT_NOW on true USE_TOOL or WAIT_OR_ABSTAIN / all true USE_TOOL or WAIT_OR_ABSTAIN
metrics.unnecessary_tool_rate: predicted USE_TOOL on true ACT_NOW / all true ACT_NOW
metrics.correct_tool_rate: exact tool name and arguments among true USE_TOOL examples
metrics.post_tool_completion_rate: post_tool_resolved examples receiving a valid legal ACT_NOW decision
metrics.structured_action_rate: responses parseable as one permitted decision or DraftGym action

selection.learned_supervisor: Hyperparameters, calibration, and safety thresholds selected on grouped development folds only.
selection.contrastive_lora: One canary plus at most one principled development-only revision. Continue only if every primary canary gate passes.
selection.heldout: No tuning, prompt changes, threshold changes, checkpoint selection, or model substitution after heldout scoring begins.

scientific_limits: The matched labels measure agreement with a conservative outcome-blind tool policy, not causal fantasy-point lift.
The frozen masked benchmark covers depth_chart and injury_status; named player_news and search are outside this milestone.
A classifier win does not establish that the main model can select good fantasy players.
Downstream paired DraftGym evaluation is required before any product-quality claim.
